rationale: The assistant immediately linked the sink replacement to backflow, asked for the right checks (sink drainage, hose routing, high loop) and, once the customer reported the hose lying flat with water appearing after emptying the sink, correctly concluded sink water was siphoning back and that a high loop plus clearing the slow trap was the fix. It used the customer's evidence faithfully and hedged the non-return valve appropriately as a last resort. The main weakness is handing the simple hose re-route to 'the sink fitter or a plumber' rather than describing it as an easy DIY task, so escalation was heavier than needed, and the first reply put filter cleaning ahead of the more likely hose-route check.
